ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including analysis of state and federal data
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much has been lost to Medicaid fraud in the state?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant waste and abuse in the Medicaid program, and could lead to reforms and increased accountability.
